archetypes.name: dyn-degraded-retry-artifacts
archetypes.rationale: Review preservation semantics around degraded review retry overwrites.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the changed degraded-panel retry path in python/review_and_fix.py. Verify attempt 1 is copied before the retry overwrites voting-tally.md, and attempt 2 is copied only after a still-degraded retry. Check that the extraction of core env parsing into a helper preserves prior fallback behavior. Look for any accidental change to retry count, warnings, or degraded state handling. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-run-log-artifact-copy
archetypes.rationale: Review run-log allowlist and copy coverage for new degraded tally artifacts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/run_logs.py and python/test_run_logs.py. Verify the new degraded tally filenames are included as normal round artifacts, not debug-only artifacts. Check that deny-list precedence still wins and the integration test proves both attempt suffixes are copied into larch-logs. Consider whether the glob is narrow enough to avoid unrelated voting tally sidecars. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
